title: Inventaire
description: Inventory card of this computer in one call: name, type (desktop, laptop, VM…), manufacturer, model, serial number (Linux: root), motherboard, BIOS and its date, CPU (cores, threads, frequency), memory, disks (model, size, SSD/HDD, bus), graphics card, operating system and install date, main IP and MAC address, domain, main user and accounts; warranty check link for the manufacturer; upgrade capacity (installed and maximum memory, memory slots used and free with the modules, expansion slots with administrator/root rights); Windows 11 compatibility (CPU, memory, storage, UEFI, Secure Boot, TPM 2.0); network cards. Findings flag upgradable memory, a serial needing root, and Windows 11 incompatibility (warning on Windows 10).

functions.name: create_label
functions.title: Étiquette d'inventaire (QR code)
functions.help: Crée une étiquette d'inventaire imprimable (fichier SVG dans Documents/SysInfo/Exports) avec un QR code : nom de la machine, modèle, n° de série, adresse MAC et date, plus le n° d'inventaire et l'attribution si on les remplit. Ouvrir le fichier dans un navigateur pour l'imprimer.
functions.description: Creates a printable inventory label (SVG) in Documents/SysInfo/Exports: computer name, model, serial number, optional asset tag and owner, MAC address, date, and a QR code holding the same information (plain text readable by any QR reader). Never overwrites a file.

parameters.name: assetTag
parameters.label: N° d'inventaire
parameters.description: Asset tag printed on the label (optional).

parameters.name: owner
parameters.label: Attribué à
parameters.description: Person or department the computer is assigned to (optional).
